question: If (sin x-cos x)/(sin x+cos x)=(2)/(5), then the value of (1+cot²x)/(1-cot²x) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

 (sin x-cos x)/(sin x+cos x)=(2)/(5)

⇒ (sin x+cos x)/(sin x-cos x)=(5)/(2) 

Applying C & D rule, we get

⇒ (sin x)/(cos x)=(5 + 2)/(5 -2) 

⇒ tan x = 7/3
